summary.text: Jeff Irwin is a Democratic member of the Michigan Senate for the 15th District, which includes parts of Ann Arbor and Ypsilanti, Saline, Tecumseh, Manchester and Milan.
The Michigan Senate Democrats biography says he is serving his second term in the Senate after representing Ann Arbor in the Michigan House from 2011 to 2017.

paragraphs.text: Irwin has a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Michigan and lives in Washtenaw County, according to his Michigan Senate Democrats biography.
He represented the City of Ann Arbor in the Michigan House of Representatives from 2011 to 2017.
The biography says that since 2018 he has introduced legislation tightening regulations on polluters and requiring schools to screen students for dyslexia.
It also says he has worked to let more juvenile offenders seal their records, expunge cannabis-related offenses, ban PFAS in food packaging and expand the Earned Income Tax Credit.
